prompt:
Author a new design system for this product and write DESIGN.md and COMPONENTS.md in the current directory. Do not ask me questions; these are all my answers.

Product: Trailmate, an iOS and Android app for hikers to plan routes and log hikes offline. Audience: casual weekend hikers. Density: calm and glanceable, often used outdoors in bright sun. Feel: grounded, sturdy, trustworthy; closest product in feel is a good paper trail map. Brand: logo color is a deep forest green; no required fonts. Color stance: neutral base with one accent plus clear status colors for weather warnings. Light and dark mode both required. Shape: soft but not pill-heavy. Motion: subtle feedback only. First screens: route list, route detail with elevation profile, live hike tracking with distance and time, and a weather warning banner.
